products.title: DEMCO Series DM 7500 Gate Valve, 2″ Seat Port, 7,500 psi
products.focusKeyword: demco dm 7500 gate valve 2 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve is a slab-gate mud valve with a 2 in (50 mm) seat port, rated 7,500 psi working pressure. Weld, flanged and hammer-union bodies are listed in test Groups 1 to 3, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve 2 inch is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat for drilling-mud service. It has a 2 in seat port (50 mm) and a 7,500 psi working pressure, and it is hydrotested to API Spec 6A testing requirements. It is not API monogrammed.

How it is built

Two identical metal wear rings are encapsulated in elastomer to form a cylinder with a gate slot and two ports. The closed gate bears on the downstream wear ring, and the elastomer gives a drop-tight, pressure-responsive seal. The body is ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class D with a 4130 bonnet, and the valve is NACE MR0175 compliant. It takes 8.6 handwheel turns from open to closed, and the open height from centre to top is 13.04 in (331 mm).

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Flanged: 10,000 psi RTJ flange, ring BX-152, flange OD 7.88 in (200 mm), 8 × 3/4 in bolts.
  • Weld: 2.00 in XXH or 3.00 in OD × 2.00 in ID.
  • Hammer union: 2 in XXH Fig 1502 hammer union.

Lengths and weights: weld ends 9.00 in (229 mm) and 38 kg; flanged 20.50 in (521 mm) and 65 kg; 2 in hammer union 15.74 in (400 mm) and 46 kg. The size table lists 29 part numbers across the three test groups. The neighbouring size is the DEMCO DM 7500 3 in gate valve.

Testing and standards

Group 1 is the basic build, with a shell test at 11,250 psi for 3 minutes and a seat test at 7,500 psi for 3 minutes on each side. Group 2 adds charted tests, a low-pressure seat test at 300 psi, impact tests at or below −50 °F (−46 °C) and surface NDE. Group 3 adds volumetric NDE on the body and bonnet. The assembly base numbers are J025088 (Group 1), J025103 (Group 2) and J025104 (Group 3).

General-service builds in the 2015 catalogue

The 2020 DEMCO catalogue lists the NACE-compliant assembly bases only. The 2015 DEMCO Gate Valves catalogue also lists general-service bases for this size, J024993, J025077, J025078, J025130, J025131, J025196, J025197, J025208, J025217 for Groups 1, 2 and 3, and the size table now carries them with their 2015 lengths and weights. It also lists a 2 in XXH weld-end valve with a 1-1/2 in bore, bases J025196, J025197, J025200, J025201, J025217, J025218. We confirm the current build against your nameplate or data sheet when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Trim options are a 410 SS stem, gate and wear rings in 41XX QPQ nitrided or 410 SS, and HNBR or FKM seals. The major repair kit is J025177-10274 and the minor kit is J025177-00274. DM 7500 parts never interchange with DM 5000 parts.

faqs.question: What materials and trim does the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve use?

faqs.question: Should I specify HNBR or FKM seats on the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?

faqs.question: Which repair kits fit the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?

faqs.question: Which spare parts are listed for the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?

faqs.question: What do Group 1, 2 and 3 mean on the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?

Group 2 adds charted 15-minute holds, a 300 psi low-pressure seat test, impact tests at or below −50 °F (−46 °C) and surface NDE. Group 3 adds volumetric NDE. For 2 in, the bases are J025088, J025103 and J025104.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in and the DM 5000 gate valve?
faqs.answer: The DM 7500 uses a ring seat insert with two wear rings sealed by O-rings, while the [DM 5000 2 in valve](/p/demco-dm-5000-gate-valve-2-inch) uses a one-piece seat assembly. The DM 7500 is the higher-pressure family, with a 10,000 psi RTJ flange on ring BX-152. Parts never interchange between the two, so match by series.

faqs.question: How do I operate and maintain the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: It closes in 8.6 handwheel turns, and the open height of 13.04 in (331 mm) sets the clearance needed above the line. The bonnet is held by 4 × 1-8 UNC × 4.50 in body studs and 2 × 3/4-10 UNC × 3.00 in studs. Replace seats, stem seal and O-rings together from a kit during overhaul, and keep wear rings with their own O-rings.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO DM 7500 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: Send the base number (J025088, J025103 or J025104), end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through [/contact](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Mention the test group and whether you need a repair kit, J025177-10274 for example, with the valve.

products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve 5-1/8 inch is a slab-gate valve with an elastomer seat for drilling-mud service. It has a 5-1/8 in seat port (130 mm) and a 7,500 psi working pressure, and it is hydrotested to API Spec 6A testing requirements. It is not API monogrammed.

How it is built

Two identical metal wear rings are encapsulated in elastomer to form a cylinder with a gate slot and two ports. The closed gate bears on the downstream wear ring, and the elastomer gives a drop-tight, pressure-responsive seal. The body is ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class D with a 4130 bonnet, and the valve is NACE MR0175 compliant. It takes 27.8 handwheel turns from open to closed, and the open height from centre to top is 31.87 in (809 mm).

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Flanged: 10,000 psi RTJ flange, ring BX-169, flange OD 14.06 in (357 mm), 12 × 1-1/8 in bolts.
  • Weld: 6.00 in XXH or 7.25 in OD × 5.12 in ID.
  • Hammer union: not offered at this size.

Lengths and weights: weld ends 17.88 in (454 mm) and 241 kg; flanged 29.00 in (737 mm) and 350 kg. The size table lists 18 part numbers across the three test groups. The neighbouring size is the DEMCO DM 7500 4 in gate valve.

Testing and standards

Group 1 is the basic build, with a shell test at 11,250 psi for 3 minutes and a seat test at 7,500 psi for 3 minutes on each side. Group 2 adds charted tests, a low-pressure seat test at 300 psi, impact tests at or below −50 °F (−46 °C) and surface NDE. Group 3 adds volumetric NDE on the body and bonnet. The assembly base numbers are J025090 (Group 1), J025109 (Group 2) and J025110 (Group 3).

General-service builds in the 2015 catalogue

The 2020 DEMCO catalogue lists the NACE-compliant assembly bases only. The 2015 DEMCO Gate Valves catalogue also lists general-service bases for this size, J024994, J025083, J025084 for Groups 1, 2 and 3, and the size table now carries them with their 2015 lengths and weights. We confirm the current build against your nameplate or data sheet when we quote.

How to order

Send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Trim options are a 410 SS stem, gate and wear rings in 41XX QPQ nitrided or 410 SS, and HNBR or FKM seals. The major repair kit is J025177-10574 and the minor kit is J025177-00574. DM 7500 parts never interchange with DM 5000 parts.

How it is built

The seat is a one-piece cylindrical assembly that fits the machined body cavity. The bonnet and a spread ring in the bottom of the seat expand it outward against the ports when the bonnet is tightened onto the seat pin extensions of both wear rings. It seals even if the gate and seat ring are scored, and the single-piece seat is easy to replace. The valve closes in 10.2 turns, and the open height from centre to top is 13.00 in (330 mm).

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Lengths and weights: weld or threaded ends 9.00 in (229 mm) and 26 kg; flanged 12.12 in (308 mm) and 47 kg; 2 in hammer union 15.74 in (400 mm) and 35 kg.

The size table lists 19 part numbers, under the assembly bases J024929 (2 in nominal ends, threaded, flanged, weld and hammer union) and J025205 (2-1/2 in nominal weld ends). The neighbouring size is the DEMCO DM 5000 3 in gate valve.

Materials and trim

The body is ASTM A105 for threaded, weld and hammer-union valves and ASTM A487 Gr 4 Class A for flanged valves, and the bonnet is ASTM A105. The stem is 316 SS (J001931-008), the gate is 41XX electroless nickel plated (J001887-002) or stainless (J001887-108 (ASTM A351 CF8M)), and the seat insert is 1045 or stainless. Seals are Buna-N or FKM. The listed trim is 316 SS stem, 41XX ENP gate, 1045 Buna-N seat and seals.

Maintenance and spares

The major repair kit is J025216-11221 and the minor kit is J025216-01221, listed as one per year of service. To order, send the base number, end connection, trim, elastomer and quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE.

General-service builds in the 2015 catalogue

How it is built

The kit is made up from the 2 in parts list in the DEMCO gate valve catalogue. The DM 7500 uses a ring seat insert with wear rings; kit parts include seat assembly 2139742-01 in HNBR or 2139741-02 in FKM and wear rings M452267 or 2139647-02.

The kits are listed for trim J0XXXXX-XX72140, which is a 410 SS stem, a 41XX QPQ gate and an HNBR seat and seals. For the 2 in size that means stem J024983-107, gate 2171111-01 and seat assembly 2139742-01, with the gate also offered in 410 SS QPQ nitrided as 2139624-02.

ItemPart numberRating

Minor repair kitJ025177-002747,500 psi

Kit numbers start J025177, then a five-digit suffix. For the 2 in size the major kit is J025177-10274 and the minor is J025177-00274, so the first digit after the dash separates major (1) from minor (0). The 2 in kits sit beside the other sizes in the same J025177 series.

Testing, interchange and spares

Listed for trim J0XXXXX-XX72140, which is a 410 SS stem, a 41XX QPQ gate and an HNBR seat and seals. Other trims: consult the maker; Indus Hydraulics confirms at quotation.

products.descriptionShort: DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve body wear rings in 41XX QPQ nitrided or 410 SS for the 2 in, 3 in, 4 in and 5-1/8 in valves. Two rings per valve, each sealed by an AS-568 O-ring, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve body wear rings are the replacement wear rings for the 7,500 psi DM 7500 slab-gate valve in 2 in, 3 in, 4 in and 5-1/8 in seat ports. Each valve uses two wear rings, either 41XX with QPQ nitriding or 410 SS, and each ring is sealed by an AS-568 O-ring. The size table lists 8 part numbers, two per size.

How it is built

The DM 7500 uses a ring seat insert with wear rings, where the DM 5000 uses a one-piece seat assembly. That is why this page lists wear rings at all: the two families never interchange, and a DM 5000 has no wear ring to replace. The rings sit in the seat of the valve body and take the closing load of the gate, so they are among the first parts to show wear in service.

Sizes and part numbers

  • 2 in: M452267 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139647-02 (410 SS).
  • 3 in: M452571 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139648-02 (410 SS).
  • 4 in: M452290 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139649-02 (410 SS).
  • 5-1/8 in: M452619 (41XX, QPQ nitrided) or 2139650-02 (410 SS).

Materials and trim

The 41XX rings carry M45xxxx numbers and the 410 SS rings carry 21396xx-02 numbers. Each listed number is for the pair of rings in one valve. Choose the material that matches the trim already in the valve, and tell us if you are not sure so it can be confirmed at quotation. The wear ring O-rings are listed on the DEMCO DM gate valve O-rings and seals page.

How to order

Send the valve size, the base number or the number stamped on the old ring, the ring material and the quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. The seat insert for the same valve is on the DM 7500 seat insert page.

products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO DM gate valve stem, 2 in, is the threaded shaft that lifts and lowers the gate in a 2 in DM mud gate valve. Two stems are listed for this seat port, one for the DM 5000 at 5,000 psi and one for the DM 7500 at 7,500 psi, and they belong to different valve families. The size table lists 8 part numbers, including the stem screw and the stem seal assemblies that go with each stem.

Which stem fits which valve

  • DM 5000: stem J001931-008 in 316 SS, with stem screw J001913 (CD 1213/15).
  • DM 7500: stem J024983-107 in 410 SS.
  • Older DM 2000–5000 valves: a stem stamped 1931-002 is listed as a stamped number.

Stem seals

The stem passes through a stem seal assembly with a bronze bushing. For the DM 5000 these are JN01949-001 (Buna-N and bronze) and JN01949-006 (FKM and bronze). For the DM 7500 they are JN23231-008 (HNBR and bronze) and JN23231-006 (FKM and bronze). The two sets are not the same, so the series decides the number.

Maintenance and spares

A stem is normally replaced together with its seal assembly, and the stem screw is checked at the same time. See the 2 in stem screw and stem packing listings. Stems for the larger seat ports are on separate pages. The DM 5000 has a one-piece seat assembly and the DM 7500 has a ring seat insert with wear rings, so parts of the two families never interchange.

How to order

Send the series, the valve base number or stamped stem number, the elastomer and the quantity through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. Give the series, seat port and elastomer on the order, and add the number stamped on the old part when you have it. This avoids a wrong match between the DM 5000 and DM 7500 families, whose parts never interchange.

DEMCO DM gate valve stem packing is the stem seal assembly, with a bronze bushing, that keeps mud from escaping past the stem on DM 5000 and DM 7500 gate valves. It is sized to the valve, so the part number depends on the series and the seat port. The size table lists 17 part numbers, including two older stamped numbers.

Part numbers by series and size

Each assembly is a bronze bushing with Buna-N or FKM on the DM 5000, and with HNBR or FKM on the DM 7500. No temperature limit is printed for these seals, so give us the mud type and operating temperature and we confirm the elastomer at quotation.

Maintenance and spares

DMA automated valves use X-2136xx stem seals, which are on the DMA repair kits and parts page. The stem itself is a separate part: see the DM 5000 stems and DM 7500 stems. DM 5000 and DM 7500 parts never interchange, so match the series first.

How to order

Send the series, size, elastomer and quantity, with the number stamped on the old assembly if you have it, through our contact page, and Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. The DEMCO DM gate valve stem screw, 2 in, is the screw that the stem runs through inside the bonnet of a 2 in DM mud gate valve. The part number is J001913, in CD 1213/15, and it appears in both the 2 in DM 5000 and the 2 in DM 7500 parts lists. The size table lists 3 part numbers.

The DM 5000 has a one-piece seat assembly and the DM 7500 a ring seat insert with wear rings, and parts of the two families otherwise never interchange, so confirm the series on the nameplate.

Maintenance and spares

Inspect the screw whenever the stem is out, and check the handwheel for roughness or play. See the 2 in stem and the stem packing listings for the parts that are normally changed with it.

How to order

products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series DM gate valve for 2,000 and 3,000 psi working pressure is a slab gate valve with an elastomer-encapsulated seat insert, in sizes from 2 in to 5 in with threaded, weld, grooved or RTJ flanged ends, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series DM gate valve for 2,000 and 3,000 psi working pressure is a slab gate valve with an elastomer-encapsulated seat insert, made in sizes from 2 in to 5 in. This page covers the DEMCO DM gate valve 2000 psi and 3,000 psi builds, and the size table lists 36 part numbers with lengths and weights.

How it is built

These valves belong to the DM 1,000 to 5,000 psi family. The seat is an insert held in elastomer, either Buna-N or FKM, and the gate is a slab. The 2015 DEMCO catalogue also lists stem seal assemblies such as J001949-XXX for the 2 in. For heavier duty, compare the DEMCO DM 5000 gate valve, 2 in.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Full port: 2, 2-1/2, 3, 4, 4-1/16 and 5 in.
  • Reduced port: 2-1/2 × 2, 4 × 3 and 5 × 4 in.
  • Ends: threaded (LP, UPTBG, casing), weld (Sch 40, 80 and 160), grooved (2,000 psi only) and RTJ flanged.
  • Lengths run from 229 mm (2 in threaded) to 406 mm (5 in threaded long casing, J021954).

Materials and trim

Threaded, weld and grooved bodies are ASTM A105 normalized. Flanged 3,000 psi bodies are ASTM A216 WCB. Stems are 303 SS or 316 SS, gates are nickel-plated AISI 1045/4140 or CF8M, and seat inserts are ductile iron, steel or 316 SS. Bodies are uncoated or have DEMCO 12 internal coating, except weld-end bodies.

Reading the part number

The assembly number is the base number plus end connection, body configuration (4 threaded, 5 weld, 6 grooved, 7 flanged), stem, gate, insert, elastomer and coating digits. Base J001026 is the 2 in 2,000 psi threaded valve.

How to order

The data on this page comes from the 2015 DEMCO catalogue, because the 2020 catalogue lists only 5,000 psi. Indus confirms the current build or part number against the nameplate when it quotes. Send the base or assembly number, size, rating, end connection, elastomer and quantity through our contact page.

products.title: DEMCO Series DM Gate Valve, ASME Class 400, 1-1/2″–6″
products.focusKeyword: demco dm gate valve class 400
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series DM gate valve in ASME Class 400 is a slab gate valve with an elastomer-encapsulated seat insert, in sizes from 1-1/2 in to 6 in with threaded, weld, grooved or flanged ends, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series DM gate valve in ASME Class 400 is a slab gate valve with an elastomer-encapsulated seat insert, made in sizes from 1-1/2 in to 6 in. This page covers the DEMCO DM gate valve class 400, and the size table lists 20 part numbers with lengths and weights.

How it is built

It belongs to the DM family, so it shares stems, seats, gates and bonnet seals with the matching Class 600 size. The 2 in valve takes stem J001279-XXX, seat J001876-0XX and gate J001275-00X. The 1-1/2 in valve takes stem J004376-XXX, seat J004081-0XX and gate J004393-00X. The neighbouring rating is the DEMCO DM gate valve, ASME Class 600.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Sizes: 1-1/2, 2, 2-1/2, 3, 4 and 6 in.
  • Ends: threaded (API LP, NU, EU and 4 in casing), weld (Sch 40 and 80), grooved, and Class 400 RF or RTJ flanged.
  • Flanged lengths are not printed for Class 400, so flanged rows carry no length.

Materials and trim

The 2 in full-port valve and the 3 to 6 in full-port valves in threaded, grooved and flanged form have ductile iron ASTM A395 bodies. All other bodies are steel ASTM A216 WCB. Stems are 303 SS or 316 SS, and gates are nickel-plated steel or 316 SS. Coatings are uncoated, DEMCO 10, DEMCO 11 or DEMCO 12, and weld-end bodies are uncoated.

Reading the part number

Each Class 400 base is the Class 600 base minus one. The 2 in Class 600 threaded base is J001072, so the Class 400 base is J001071. Coating codes are -0X0 uncoated, -0X1 DEMCO 10, -0X4 DEMCO 11 and -0X5 DEMCO 12.

How to order

The data on this page comes from the 2005 Cameron DEMCO submittal sheets G-4 and G-9, with body materials from the 2015 catalogue. Indus confirms the current build or part number against the nameplate when it quotes. Send the base number, size, end connection, elastomer, coating and quantity through our contact page.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO Series DM gate valve, ASME Class 400, and where is it used?
faqs.answer: It is a DM slab gate valve with an elastomer-encapsulated seat insert, rated ASME Class 400, for general service. The size table lists 20 part numbers from 1-1/2 in to 6 in. Indus Hydraulics quotes it from Dubai, UAE, with the nameplate checked against the 2005 submittal sheets.

faqs.question: Which sizes and end connections does the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve come in?
faqs.answer: Sizes are 1-1/2, 2, 2-1/2, 3, 4 and 6 in. Ends are threaded (API LP, NU, EU, and 4 in casing), weld (Sch 40 and 80), grooved, and Class 400 RF or RTJ flanged. The 1-1/2 in valve is listed as threaded only, base J003932.

faqs.question: How long and heavy is the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve in 2 in and 6 in?
faqs.answer: The 2 in threaded J001071 is 226 mm long and weighs 12 kg. The 6 in threaded J001079 is 394 mm long and weighs 141 kg, and the 4 in J001077 sits between them at 302 mm and 44 kg. Class 400 flanged lengths are not printed on the sheet.

faqs.question: What is the body material of the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve, ductile iron or steel?
faqs.answer: It depends on size and ends. The 2 in full-port valve, and 3 to 6 in full-port valves in threaded, grooved and flanged form, are ductile iron ASTM A395. All other bodies are steel ASTM A216 WCB. The 6 in J001079 threaded body, for example, is ductile iron.

faqs.question: Which stem, gate and elastomer options apply to the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve?
faqs.answer: Stems are 303 SS or 316 SS, gates are nickel-plated steel or 316 SS, and seat inserts are ductile iron, steel or 316 SS. Elastomer is Buna-N or FKM, and older sheets show a Hypalon/Buna-N option. No temperature limits are printed, so Indus confirms them at quotation.

faqs.question: How do I read a DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve part number?
faqs.answer: Each Class 400 base is the Class 600 base minus one, so the 2 in Class 600 threaded J001072 becomes J001071. Coating is the last code: -0X0 uncoated, -0X1 DEMCO 10, -0X4 DEMCO 11 and -0X5 DEMCO 12. The 3 in threaded base is J001075.

faqs.question: Which spare parts fit the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve, 2 in and 1-1/2 in?
faqs.answer: The 2 in valve takes stem J001279-XXX, seat J001876-0XX and gate J001275-00X, shared with the Class 600 size. The 1-1/2 in valve takes stem J004376-XXX, seat J004081-0XX and gate J004393-00X. See [gate valve repair kits](/c/gate-valve-repair-kits) and send the nameplate.

faqs.question: What testing and approvals apply to the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve, 4 in?
faqs.answer: The sheets print no test-group schedule or approvals for the 4 in J001077 or any other Class 400 size, and the 2015 data states no API monogram. A 4-1/16 in Class 400 valve is drawn on sheet G-14 with a 4.06 in bore, but its base number is not legible, so send the nameplate.

faqs.question: How does the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve differ from the Class 600 valve?
faqs.answer: Dimensions are shared for threaded, weld and grooved ends, for example A 8.88 in on the 2 in. The base numbers differ by one, and body materials follow the size, as in the 2 in ductile iron body. See the [DEMCO DM gate valve, ASME Class 600](/p/demco-dm-gate-valve-asme-class-600).

faqs.question: How should I install the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve, 2-1/2 in and 3 in?
faqs.answer: Match the end connection first: the 2-1/2 in is J001073 threaded, J001093 weld, J001083 grooved or J001063 flanged. The 3 in is J001075, J001095, J001085 or J001065. Lengths are 254 mm and 260 mm on threaded and weld ends, and weights are 23 kg and 27 kg.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO DM Class 400 data current, and how does Indus confirm the part?
faqs.answer: The data comes from 2005 Cameron submittal sheets G-4 and G-9, with body materials from the 2015 catalogue p.37, so it is older than the current catalogue. Indus checks the nameplate and base number, such as J001097 for the 4 in weld valve, before quoting.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO DM Class 400 gate valve, 1-1/2 in to 6 in?
faqs.answer: Send the base number, size, end connection, elastomer, coating and quantity through [our contact page](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. If you only have the nameplate, send a photograph, for example one marked J001099 for the 6 in weld valve.

products.title: DEMCO Series DT Gate Valve, 2″, ASME Class 600, 900 & 1500, Aluminium Bronze, NACE
products.focusKeyword: demco dt gate valve 2 inch
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series DT 2 in gate valve is an aluminium bronze through-conduit gate valve for waterflood and CO2 injection, in ASME Class 600, 900 and 1500 with a 2.06 in seat bore, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series DT 2 in gate valve is a through-conduit slab gate valve for waterflood and CO2 injection in enhanced oil recovery. This page covers the DEMCO DT gate valve 2 inch in ASME Class 600, 900 and 1500, and the size table lists 10 part numbers. It is not a drilling-mud valve.

How it is built

The body and bonnet are aluminium bronze ASTM B148 Alloy 955, or stainless steel CF8M as an option. Wetted parts comply with NACE RP-0475. The seat bore is 2.06 in (52 mm). The standard seat is a 316 SS seat ring encapsulated in peroxide-cured Buna-N, and FKM, HNBR or P-10 seats are options. The valve is field repairable in line with the bonnet off and no special tools, and the rising stem shows position. A four-ring stem packing set isolates the stem threads from line media.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Class 600: 1,480 psi, J024997, 22 kg.
  • Class 900: 2,220 psi, J024998, 37 kg flanged or 20 kg threaded.
  • Class 1500: 3,705 psi, J024999, 37 kg flanged or 20 kg threaded.

Ends are RF or RTJ flanged, and threaded API LP or UPTBG on Class 900 and 1500. Flanged RF length is 292 mm at Class 600 and 368 mm at Class 900 and 1500.

Reading the part number

The assembly number is the base plus end connection digit (2 for 600 RTJ up to 7 for 1500 RF), body configuration, stem, gate and seat ring digits, seat insert and seal code, and body material, 6 for aluminium bronze. Seat, gate and bonnet-seal numbers follow the seat code.

How to order

The data comes from the 2015 DEMCO catalogue. Indus confirms the current build or part number against the nameplate when it quotes. Send the base or assembly number, class, end connection, seat code and quantity through our contact page. Parts are on the DEMCO DT gate valve parts page.

faqs.question: What is the DEMCO Series DT 2 in gate valve, and where is it used?

faqs.question: What pressure ratings does the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve have?
faqs.answer: It is made in ASME Class 600, 900 and 1500. Working pressure with an aluminium bronze body is 1,480 psi at Class 600, 2,220 psi at Class 900 and 3,705 psi at Class 1500. A stainless flanged body is 1,440, 2,160 and 3,600 psi.

faqs.question: How long and heavy is the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: The Class 600 flanged valve J024997 is 292 mm RF or 295 mm RTJ and weighs 22 kg. The Class 900 J024998 and Class 1500 J024999 flanged valves are 368 mm RF or 371 mm RTJ and weigh 37 kg. Threaded Class 900 and 1500 valves are 216 mm and 20 kg.

faqs.question: What are the body and trim materials of the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: The body and bonnet are aluminium bronze ASTM B148 Alloy 955, or stainless steel CF8M as an option. The gate and seat ring are CF8M stainless, and the stem is 316 SS. Wetted parts comply with NACE RP-0475, and the stem packing is a four-ring set.

faqs.question: Which seat and elastomer options does the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve offer?
faqs.answer: The standard seat is a 316 SS ring in peroxide-cured Buna-N. Options are FKM, HNBR, or a P-10 seat, a PEEK insert with an Inconel X-750 spring, with Buna-N, HNBR, FKM or AFLAS seal. Seat assembly 2061588-01 is the CF8M and Buna-N seat for this 2 in size.

faqs.question: How do I read a DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve part number?
faqs.answer: The base for the 2 in is J024997, J024998 or J024999 by class. The end connection digit runs from 2 (600 RTJ) to 7 (1500 RF), then body configuration, and stem, gate and seat ring digits of 8 for SS. The seat code runs 1 to 9, and body material 6 is aluminium bronze.

faqs.question: Which repair parts fit the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: The 2 in valve takes gate J024558-008 with seat codes 1, 2 and 5, stem J024089-008, stem seal assembly J024882-601 and handle 2139937-01. Bonnet seals are J005520-234 for Buna-N and J005521-234 for FKM. See [DEMCO DT gate valve parts](/p/demco-dt-gate-valve-parts).

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve NACE compliant or API monogrammed?
faqs.answer: Body, bonnet and all wetted parts comply with NACE RP-0475, and the 2015 data lists no API monogram and no test pressures for the 2 in J024997. Indus confirms any test or documentation requirement against the nameplate before it quotes the order.

faqs.question: How does the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve differ from the 2-1/2 in and DM valves?
faqs.answer: Series DT uses a CF8M seat ring and a bronze or stainless body, so DT parts do not fit DM valves. The 2 in seat bore is 2.06 in, and the next size up is the [DEMCO DT gate valve, 2-1/2 in](/p/demco-dt-gate-valve-2-1-2-inch). The 2 in Class 600 valve weighs 22 kg.

faqs.question: How do I install and maintain the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: Match the end connection to the line: flanged RTJ uses ring R-23 at Class 600 and R-24 at Class 900 and 1500. The valve is repaired in line by taking the bonnet off, with no special tools, using nuts 2709000-07-11 at Class 600 and 2709000-08-11 at 900 and 1500.

faqs.question: Is the DEMCO DT 2 in data current, and how does Indus confirm the part?
faqs.answer: The data comes from the 2015 DEMCO catalogue, pp.9, 10, 44 and 45, and is not a statement of current build. Body part numbers are not printed, so Indus checks the nameplate and base number, such as J024998, before quoting.

faqs.question: How do I order the DEMCO DT 2 in gate valve?
faqs.answer: Send the base or assembly number, ASME class, end connection, seat code, body material and quantity through [our contact page](/contact). Indus Hydraulics quotes from Dubai, UAE. A nameplate photograph marked J024997, J024998 or J024999 is enough to start.

The DEMCO Series DT 3 in gate valve is a through-conduit slab gate valve for waterflood and CO2 injection in enhanced oil recovery. This page covers the DEMCO DT gate valve 3 inch in ASME Class 600, 900 and 1500, and the size table lists 7 rows. It is not a drilling-mud valve.

How it is built

The body and bonnet are aluminium bronze ASTM B148 Alloy 955, and wetted parts comply with NACE RP-0475. The seat bore is 3.12 in (79 mm). The standard seat is a 316 SS seat ring encapsulated in peroxide-cured Buna-N, with FKM, HNBR or P-10 seats as options. The valve is field repairable in line with the bonnet off and no special tools. The rising stem shows position, and four stem packing rings isolate the stem threads from line media.

Sizes, ratings and end connections

  • Class 600: J025003, 1,480 psi, 45 kg, RF 356 mm or RTJ 359 mm.
  • Class 900: J025004, 2,220 psi, 57 kg flanged, RF 381 mm or RTJ 384 mm.
  • Class 1500: J025005, 3,705 psi, 84 kg, RF 470 mm or RTJ 473 mm.
  • Threaded API LP at Class 900: 246 mm and 34 kg.

Materials and trim

The gate and seat ring are CF8M stainless, and the stem is 316 SS. The Class 1500 valve takes a different stem, J024820-008, a different bonnet, J024642-006, and handle 2139932-01 from the Class 600 and 900 valve. Seat assemblies 2061588-03, 2061589-03 and 2061590-03 cover Buna-N, FKM and PEEK-insert seats.

How to order

The data comes from the 2015 DEMCO catalogue, and Indus confirms the current build or part number against the nameplate when it quotes. Send the base or assembly number, class, end connection, seat code and quantity through our contact page. Spares are on the DEMCO DT gate valve parts page.

products.descriptionLong:
These DEMCO Series DT gate valve parts fit the 2, 2-1/2, 3 and 4 in valve in Class 600, 900 and 1500 and the 6 in valve in Class 900. This page lists seat assemblies, gates, stems, bonnets, stem seal assemblies, bonnet seals, studs, nuts and handles, and the size table lists 129 part numbers for the DEMCO DT gate valve parts range.

Which valves the parts fit

The parts fit the corrosion-resistant DT gate valve used for waterflood and CO2 injection, not the DM gate valve. DT parts do not fit DM valves: the DT uses a CF8M seat ring with an encapsulated elastomer or P-10 insert, and an aluminium bronze or stainless body. The valves themselves are on the DEMCO DT gate valve, 2 in page and its size siblings.

Reading the seat code

Seat assembly, gate and bonnet seal part numbers are keyed to the seat insert and seal code in the valve assembly number. Codes 1, 2 and 5 are elastomer seats. Codes 6 to 9 are P-10 seats with a PEEK insert. A gate for codes 1, 2 and 5 is a different part from a gate for codes 6 to 9, so give the full assembly number or nameplate.

Materials and trim

  • Seat assemblies: CF8M ring with Buna-N, FKM or HNBR, or CF8M ring, PEEK insert, Inconel X-750 spring and Buna-N, HNBR, FKM or AFLAS seal.
  • Gate: CF8M.
  • Stem: 316 SS, with XM-19 on the 4 in Class 1500.

Examples from the table

For the 2 in valve, seat assembly 2061588-01 is CF8M with Buna-N, 2061589-01 is FKM and 2227057-01 is HNBR. For the 2-1/2 in, the equivalents end in -02, for example 2061588-02. Where the catalogue prints no number, such as HNBR seats on 2-1/2 in to 6 in and body part numbers, Indus quotes from the valve nameplate.

How to order

The data comes from the 2015 DEMCO catalogue, pp.45 to 53. Indus confirms the current part number against the nameplate. Send the valve size, class, seat code and part description through our contact page.

products.title: DEMCO Series DB Gate Valve, 6″ and 8″ × 6″, Aluminium Bronze, ASME 600–1500
products.focusKeyword: demco db gate valve
products.descriptionShort: The DEMCO Series DB gate valve is an aluminium bronze slab gate valve for large waterflood and CO2 injection lines, in 6 in full port and 8 × 6 in reduced port, ASME Class 600 to 1500, from Indus Hydraulics, Dubai.
products.descriptionLong:
The DEMCO Series DB gate valve is an aluminium bronze slab gate valve for the large 6 in and 8 in pipe sizes in enhanced oil recovery, covering waterflood and CO2 injection. This page covers the DEMCO DB gate valve in 6 in full port and 8 × 6 in reduced port, and the size table lists 5 configurations.

How the seat is built

The seat is two identical metal wear rings encapsulated in elastomer. Together they form a cylinder with a gate slot and two round ports, the same design as the Series DM. The closed gate bears on the downstream wear ring, and the elastomer seals round the port. That means the seat still seals if the gate and seat ring are scored. The valve is field repairable in line.

Sizes and ratings

  • 6 in full port: ASME Class 600, 900 and 1500.
  • 8 × 6 in reduced port: ASME Class 600 and 900.
  • Ends: flanged.

Materials and trim

The body and bonnet are aluminium bronze as standard, and internal parts are 316 SS. The seat elastomer is peroxide-cured Buna-N, with FKM as an option.

Drawings and base numbers

The 2015 catalogue prints no Series DB dimensions or base numbers. The size table therefore lists the configurations only, and drawings and base numbers come with the quotation. Send the nameplate if you already have a valve installed. For a Series DT valve in 6 in, see the DEMCO DT gate valve, 6 in.

Related items

The catalogue also lists accessories for complete injection assemblies: ball check valves, flow tees and strainers. Ask for them in the same enquiry.

How to order

The data comes from the 2015 DEMCO catalogue, pp.9 and 11. Indus confirms the current build against the nameplate when it quotes. Send the size, ASME class, seat elastomer and quantity through our contact page.

What the page lists

  • Bonnets for Group 1, 2 and 3 testing.
  • Handles, handwheels, lock handles and housings.
  • Packing retainers, stem tubes, stem caps, keys and bearings.
  • Body and housing studs and nuts, cotter pins and lube fittings.

Materials and trim

Bonnets are ASTM A487 Grade 4 Class D. Studs are ASTM A193 B7 or L7, and nuts are ASTM A194 2H or 7. B7 and 2H bolting is standard, and L7 and 7 bolting is the low-temperature option. The 3 in stem is 410 SS, J024951-107, and the 3 in bearing is PTFE and phenolic, J007426.

For the 2 in valve, the handle is 2139712-01 and the lock handle is J001891. Three bonnet numbers are listed: J024985-030, 2140428-01 and 2140341-01. For the 3 in valve the handle is 2139481-01 and the bonnets are J017289-029, 2140370-01 and 2140370-02. For complete valves see the DEMCO DM 7500 gate valve, 3 in.

products.descriptionLong:
These DEMCO DM gate valve bonnets and parts fit the DM 2,000, 3,000 and 5,000 psi valves in 2 in to 5 in and the ASME Class 400, 600, 900 and 1500 valves in 1-1/2 in to 6 in. The size table lists 124 part numbers. These parts never fit DM 7500 valves.

What the page lists

  • Bonnets, stems, gates and seat assemblies.
  • Handles, hub assemblies, lock handles, stem screws and screw housings.
  • Retainers, couplings, index pins and stem seal assemblies.
  • Body studs and nuts.

Reading the suffix codes

The suffix XXX or 0XX carries the material or coating. Stems end -002 for 303 SS or -008 for 316 SS. Bonnets end -030 for uncoated or -035 for DEMCO 12. Gates end -002 for nickel-plated steel or -008 for CF8M. Seat inserts end -01X for ductile iron or steel, -02X for steel on the 4 in, or -08X for 316 SS. The elastomer is -0X1 for Buna-N or -0X2 for FKM.

Examples from the table

For the 2 in valve, the stem is J001931-XXX, the bonnet is J001237-XXX, the gate is J001887-XXX and the seat assembly is J001876-0XX. For the 2-1/2 and 3 in valve, the hub assembly is 2139713-01 and the lock handle is J001892. For the 4 in and 5 × 4 in, the hub assembly is 2139714-01. The valves themselves are on the DEMCO DM gate valve, 2,000 and 3,000 psi page.

Shared parts and older valves

The 2,000 to 5,000 psi family and the ASME classes share many parts by size, for example the 2 in seat assembly J001876-0XX and the 4 in seat J002207-0XX. Valves made before 1994 may use seven-pitch stud J002075 and nut J053251-042.
